title: Straeva Labs: the investor pitch
event: Startup Expo Case Competition · Rendezvous ’26 · IIT Delhi
ask: Raise ₹100 Cr for a Bengaluru wearable health-tech company at a ₹1,000 Cr pre-money valuation, and convince a panel of judges and VCs it is worth it.
answer: A pitch deck with a three-slide appendix: a $298B wearables and corporate-wellness market narrowed to a ₹6,000 Cr serviceable market and a ₹658–822 Cr revenue goal, unit economics with 71% blended retention and a 2.7-month CAC payback, and 9.09% dilution on the ask.
mine: The market sizing and the financial appendix: TAM to SAM to SOM, the retention and payback maths, and the numbers behind the ask.
note: Case and data provided by the organisers.

title: VoltEdge: a battery-swapping network that can afford a lifetime warranty
ask: Design a battery-swapping network for electric two-wheelers in India that can carry a lifetime battery warranty and still make money, over a five-to-seven-year horizon.
answer: A separate battery bank owns the packs, riders buy a “virtual battery” with an 80% health floor, and the network rolls out from Bengaluru in 2027. Each ₹52 lakh hub pays back in about five years at a 15–17% return.
mine: The financial-viability slide: CAPEX, OPEX, pricing and ROI. I built it and presented it to the judges.
note: Case and data provided by the organisers.

title: Velenor Capital: growing to ₹60,000 Cr without hurting returns
event: Startup Expo Case Competition · Round 2 · Rendezvous ’26 · IIT Delhi
ask: Grow Velenor Capital from ₹31,200 Cr to ₹60,000 Cr by FY29 while keeping capital adequacy and return on equity above 16%, after new 2025 digital lending rules made its fintech-partner loans far more expensive to hold.
answer: Tier all 42 fintech partners by risk-adjusted return (co-lend, reprice or exit), build an in-house risk engine on partner data, and redeploy capital into the ₹12,500 Cr MSME franchise.
mine: We built this deck as a team: the partner tiering, the in-house risk engine and the plan to move capital into MSME lending.
note: Case and data provided by the organisers.
